tool_specs./tools/full-and-final-settlement-calcula: Inputs: monthly gross, basic+DA, last working day, unpaid days, leave balance (days), notice served/shortfall days, years of service, bonus/incentive due, deductions claimed. Lines: unpaid salary = gross/days-in-month × unpaid days; leave encashment = (basic+DA)/26 × leave days (state/company policy — make divisor editable); notice recovery = per-day rate × shortfall (basic or gross toggle — link to notice-period tool); gratuity via the gratuity formula if eligible. Output: itemised table + 'due within 2 working days of exit under s.17(2) Code on Wages†'.
tool_specs./tools/gratuity-calculator: Gratuity = last drawn (basic + DA) × 15/26 × completed years (service ≥ 6 months in the final year rounds up). Eligibility: 5 years continuous service (exceptions: death/disablement); fixed-term employees eligible pro-rata after 1 year under the Code on Social Security†. Show statutory ceiling as an editable 'as of' value (verify current ceiling). Payment due within 30 days of becoming payable; interest on delay.
tool_specs./tools/notice-period-recovery-calculator: Inputs: notice period required, days served, monthly basic, monthly gross, contract clause (basic/gross/unspecified). Output: recovery on basic vs gross, flag when employer's deduction exceeds the contract or is applied to statutory dues; cite Contract Act s.74 (reasonable compensation).
tool_specs./tools/cheque-bounce-deadline-calculator: Inputs: cheque date, presentation date, date of receipt of return memo, date notice delivered (optional). Rules: cheque validity 3 months from its date; demand notice within 30 days of receiving information of dishonour (s.138(b)); drawer gets 15 days from receipt of notice (s.138(c)); complaint within 1 month after the 15-day period expires (s.142(1)(b)); delay condonable with sufficient cause. Output: dated timeline + warnings if any deadline is past.
tool_specs./tools/msme-delayed-payment-interest-cal: Inputs: invoice amount, invoice/acceptance date, agreed credit days (cap 45), payment date (or today), RBI bank rate (editable, show 'as of' and link to RBI). Interest = compound with monthly rests at 3 × bank rate from the appointed day (s.16 MSMED Act). Output: month-by-month table, total interest, downloadable CSV, 43B(h) note for buyers.
tool_specs./tools/rera-refund-interest-calculator: Inputs: amounts paid with dates (multiple rows), refund date, interest rate (default = SBI highest MCLR + 2% per state rules — editable with 'as of'). Interest computed per payment from its date to refund date (simple interest unless state rule says otherwise). Output: per-instalment table and total.
tool_specs./tools/consumer-commission-fee-jurisdict: Input: consideration paid (value of goods/services). Jurisdiction: District ≤ ₹50 lakh; State > ₹50 lakh to ≤ ₹2 crore; National > ₹2 crore (2021 notification). Fee slabs per Consumer Protection (Consumer Commission Procedure) Regulations 2020† — encode in src/data with source link; verify before publishing (e.g., nil up to ₹5 lakh).
tool_specs./tools/money-suit-court-fee-calculator: State-wise ad-valorem court-fee schedules differ. Implement only for states whose schedule you can verify from an official source (start with Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Tamil Nadu); store schedules in src/data/court-fees.ts with source URL + 'as of'; other states show 'verify with court' message. Never guess a slab.
tool_specs./tools/limitation-period-calculator: Claim types → Limitation Act articles: money lent (Art. 19/21, 3 yrs from loan/demand), goods sold (Art. 14), work done (Art. 18), promissory note (Art. 34/35), general (Art. 113); consumer complaint 2 yrs (s.69 CPA); cheque complaint per s.142. Extensions: written acknowledgment (s.18) and part-payment (s.19) restart the clock. Output: expiry date + extension explanation + 'consult a lawyer if within 60 days of expiry'.
